name: Spouse Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Spouses of Zimbabwean citizens, or spouses accompanying a long-term work permit holder, may apply for a Spouse Residence Permit valid up to 12 months and renewable in-country -- renewal for the second category is tied to the sponsoring spouse's own work permit remaining valid. Work authorization can be requested alongside the application if separately qualifying. Requires a support letter from the sponsor, a guarantee form from a close relative, proof of accommodation/funds from the guarantor, a certified marriage certificate, a radiology certificate, and police clearance.
requirements.fix_path: Apply with the sponsor's support letter, a relative's guarantee, marriage certificate, radiology certificate, and police clearance.

evidence_required.document: Guarantee form from a close relative, with proof of accommodation/funds

sources.title: Work Permit Zimbabwe (private immigration-services site) -- Spouse Residence Permit eligibility, 12-month renewable duration, and documentary requirements including the relative's guarantee form
